notes: ping_ms comes from the server's own keep-alive RTT, the same number /spark ping shows

sent/received.packets counts frames at the compression boundary, not logical packets: a large packet split into several frames counts more than once, and every tick adds two bundle-delimiter frames (~2/s * 20 ticks). bytes are compressed payload bytes, no frame length prefix
packets_per_s / bytes_per_s need two captures: the first poll after a player joins reports 0
null ping means the connection has not completed a round trip yet
